snippet.title: THE OMEGA REACH reveal trailer
snippet.description:
Reach for the stars, gather their instruments, and curate the best collection in the universe! THE OMEGA REACH is a point-and-click museum simulator (and dungeon crawler) which makes you feel like a musical genius.

Wishlist on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4638520/THE_OMEGA_REACH/

Play demo on itch.io
https://shiftbacktick.itch.io/the-omega-reach
